tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App ground behind every screen and the graph canvas.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, the top bar, table rows, graph nodes at rest.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the selected node, hovered rows.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: inputs, the event log, meter tracks, code and trail blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel borders. Decorative only, never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, graph edges, node outlines. 3:1 on bg, surface and raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, raised and sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, surface, raised and sunken: justifications, meta, table secondary columns.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on bg, surface, raised and sunken: timestamps, sequence numbers, uppercase labels. Never for body copy.

tokens.name: steer
tokens.usage: The user's hand. Text, icons and borders for anything the user did or is asked to do: instructions, interventions, approval. Reads on bg, surface, raised, sunken and steer-wash. Also the fill of the one primary action per view.

tokens.name: on-steer
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a steer fill.

tokens.name: steer-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for instruction blocks, user rows in the event log, the composer header.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Agents at work. Running and waiting-on-children status, activity verbs, live edges. Reads on bg, surface, raised, sunken and live-wash.

tokens.name: live-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of a running node and of live pills.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Settled and holding: Completed nodes, Confirmed and Supported claims, Primary sources. A blue-leaning teal so it never relies on red-green contrast with danger. Reads on bg, surface, raised, sunken and ok-wash.

tokens.name: ok-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of ok pills and confirmed-claim markers.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs attention but nothing is lost: Paused, Retrying, Contested claims, budget above 80%. Reads on bg, surface, raised, sunken and warn-wash.

tokens.name: warn-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of warn pills and system-pause banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Broken or false: Failed nodes, Refuted claims and premises, Rejected proposals, destructive actions. Reads on bg, surface, raised, sunken and danger-wash.

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of danger pills, the Where-you-were-wrong block, delete confirmation.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px, 2px offset. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind the delete confirmation, the only modal in the app.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen titles on Investigations, Settings, and the report's answer.
styles.sample: Why is the Great Wall visible from space?

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Investigation title in the board header; section titles in Settings and the report.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel heads, node question in the inspector, table primary column.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text: verdicts, claims, instructions, form copy.
styles.sample: No astronaut has reported seeing the Wall unaided from low Earth orbit.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Graph node titles, queue rows, hints under fields.
styles.sample: Takes effect at each node's next step.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and column heads. Always ink-faint.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Activity lines, event log, URLs, queries, money, counts, node ids.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Node kind codes, sequence numbers, keyboard hints, pill glyphs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its word; pill padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside rows and between sibling controls; node padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel head padding; gap between stacked blocks in the inspector.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; page gutter at narrow widths.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; page gutter on list and settings screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between settings groups and report sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top padding of list and settings screens; empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pills' inner tags, kind codes, keyboard hints, meter bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, graph nodes, panels, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The instruction composer and banners: the two things that ask for the user.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and segmented controls only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers only. Panels and nodes are flat and separated by line.
